description: This source file defines a utility module for interacting with email notification endpoints via HTTP requests. It provides functions to send notifications for new bookings and status changes, handling responses and errors, intended for use in a React application during development with CRA proxy setup.

methods.name: notifyNewBooking(booking)
methods.description: Sends an admin notification about a new booking via POST request to the API endpoint, returns a promise resolving to an object indicating success or failure.

methods.name: notifyStatusChange(payload)
methods.description: Sends a status change email to a customer via POST request, returns a promise resolving to an object indicating success or failure.
